verdict.rationale: Framer's docs show motion and effects across sites, plus agent-built animated menus, interactive carousels and sticky navbars. Code overrides can modify layer and component properties, and the community calls Framer strong for advanced prototyping with animations and transitions. Community reports of occasional animation stutter and distortion during size changes are quality caveats, not contradictions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of state-to-state animation (variants), no-code conditions or variables logic, dedicated scroll-triggered or scroll-linked effects, and in-depth first-party prototyping docs.
